reviewerOrPass: Worker B, same AI, separate source-first pass
method: Worker B, same AI, separate source-first final pass. Reopened the adopted HGP programme credit and progression tables and the actual current Building/Real Estate/Moving and methods/thesis entries, then compared their underlying subject and entry claims against the frozen finished decision/canonical and all current UCR contributions. Reconsidered substantive comparability, partial relationships and gaps instead of only replaying validators. Same AI analytical separation, not an independent person or actual rendering.
findings: The current ordinary English HGP pathway retains Planning as a valid existing specialisation independent of UCR fit. Adopted OER and dated tree agree on three specialisations and eighteen track credits; stale introductory prose about two specialisations/twenty-four credits does not override them. Year one sixty, year two sixty and year three sixty total 180 unique EC. Only the English Netherlands field course is selected; no duplicate language version or extra optional internship is counted.

Building the City is twelve EC and belongs in the current year-two thematic list; its separate six-credit seminar is Planning and Real Estate in Urban Development. The old year-two Contesting and six-credit Building reconstruction is invalid. Building/Real Estate form a coherent actual property/planning combination, with earlier completed year one/BSA. The valid prior twelve-credit Moving in the City thematic remains in year three and addresses transport/accessibility/land-use systems. Thirty free credits remain genuinely open within academic-level, enrolment and approval rules.

Current OER B4.5 requires Thinking Spatially followed before Methods 1, Methods 1 passed before Methods 2, Academic Skills passed and participation/minimum Methods 2 for Netherlands fieldwork. Abroad also needs Regional project and Academic Skills passed, with Methods 2 participation. The normal block placement permits those conditions; no prior-pass requirement is invented where participation is sufficient. Methods 3 requires Methods 2 and Netherlands passed and normally runs concurrently with the thesis. The thesis needs all year one, Methods 2 and Netherlands passed plus Methods 3 participation. This is individual original qualitative/quantitative research within thematic supervision groups, not an extra group thesis.

The defined subject combines geographical concepts of place/space/scale and social processes with planning theories, institutions and interventions, GIS and empirical field methods. Building and Real Estate add actual property development and valuation/actor practices; Moving adds mobility planning. UCR’s dedicated theoretical/property/mobility and overseas-field limits are preserved rather than obscured by broad partial matches.

All sixty-three interests were reconciled: sixteen direct/stable generators, thirty supporting topics, six illustrations and eleven conditional outcomes. Closest owns fourteen generators including Planning; Human Geography and Global Urbanism/Transnational Planning independently ground the additional purposes. Candidate roles do not promise dedicated housing/mobility training, automatic professional qualification or further-study admission. Narrowed the global title/concept to actual global connections, identity and place rather than sustained migration training.

Three coherent UCR responses have genuine place-based substance and specified complementary roles. Closest connects GIS, environmental evidence, climate/water adaptation and partner research with sociological, economic and public-policy inquiry. Public option focuses on collective institutions, rights/property, inclusion and policy communication. Global option studies actual imperial/Indigenous/racial and Mediterranean/African histories and international connections, supported by social and historical methods. Four substitutions replace weaker materials/product/educational-extremism choices with policy, public economics and social psychology. Pairwise differences of 67.5, 82.5 and 52.5 credits each way change academic purposes as well as passing the floor.

Thirty-nine actual UCR contributions were reviewed. Earth Observation teaches real ArcGIS Pro spatial analysis and remote sensing. Earth System Tools is climate/proxy modelling, not urban statistics. Leading Under Pressure teaches minority/psychological safety plus a real supervised survey-analysis project; Private Law is property/tort/contract, not an unsupported tenancy course. Description-only social movements, climate communication, econometrics, policy, American Century historical research and Mediterranean art connections receive full supported consideration. Excluded Walcheren material is not used.

Ten partial placements and eight meaningful gaps follow actual content or bounded educational functions. Interview/coding and GIS have concrete relationships; water-governance inquiry shares the place/environment/institutions strand of urban dynamics. Partner research, supervised survey inquiry and conflict-policy research/design have explicit subject/method limits against their regional/residential/thesis-method comparator functions. No one-to-one equivalence test determines gaps. Dedicated planning/property/mobility, overseas fieldwork, free study and individual thesis stay visible. Optional UCR research is additional to 180 scheduled credits.

All schedules pass current covered offerings, earlier formal prerequisites, twenty-four unique courses/four each term, first-year PPD and at least six advanced courses. Six initial offering conflicts are repaired without restoring historical availability. Research in a Sustainable Delta has no formal prerequisite and only 2026h2 availability, so its first-year placement is explicit; no later term or advisory hard prerequisite is invented. Other social/political foundations precede advanced theory where feasible.

Read record/index English title, three labels/concepts, eighteen component labels and credits, twelve notes, all audience and source references, partial explanations/gaps and thirty-nine unchanged shared description selections through the established mapping. No app/renderer, workbook or enrichment change, Shiny/browser, screenshots/modals, independent human or final release approval is claimed.
